Title: Mata Hari's Special text summary and questions

Messages.Author: Vezintroll.
Messages.Body:
Hello,

I need a Summary of Mata Hari's Special text and vampires with the same ability to explain how it works.

1. When you use the special text to play a card, you are considered to meet this requirement (clan, title, sect, etc.) until the played effect resolves. Examples of this rule:

Action cards: During the action action is considered member of the clan. Combat cards: If it is a Strike, it will be considered to belong to the clan Clan until the resolution of the Strike. If not, it will be considered to belong to the clan for the duration of the effect (one round, during the combat, etc.) Master cards: It will be considered member of the clan until the effect of the master ends Reactions and action modifiers cards: It will be considered member of the clan until the effect of the card ends.  2.These vampires cannot use cards already in play that require a clan to use, but they can use cards that require a vampire or minion. For example:

Matahari can use the especial text of The Ankara Citadel, Turkey because says: Non-action modifier cards costing blood cost this vampire half as much blood to play, rounded down. Matahari can't use the especial text of Erebus Mask because says: The Harbinger of Skulls with this equipment gets +1 Stealth.
3. These abilities do not allow you to meet the requirements of cards that are not played normally, for example when cards such as Concealed Weapon, Piper or The Summoning are used.

It's all correct? Are there any other rules that I haven't considered?

If it is correct, I have some questions:

If Mata Hari plays SchreckNET and there is a The Labyrinth in play (controlled by the same matuselah) Can I tap The labirinth to give +1 Stealth to Mata Hari during this action?
If Mata Hari plays SchreckNET and during the action plays Stiff Contempt, What Clan is Mata Hari during this action? Nosferatu, Samedi or Both (Multiclan)?
If Mata Hari have a Razor Bat, and plays Raking Talons. Is Mata Hari Gargoyle until the end of the combat? Do the razorbat any damage during this combat?
Does Vidal Jarbeaux's special text (diferent wording) working like Matahari's special text?

CARD TEXTS

Mata Hari
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Ravnos
Group: 4
Capacity: 7
Discipline: aus for qui CHI OBF
Independent. 2 votes (titled): You and Mata Hari can play cards requiring a sect and/or clan as if she were of that required sect and/or clan. Red List.

Vidal Jarbeaux
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Toreador
Group: 5
Capacity: 8
Discipline: aus cel obf pot PRE
Camarilla: Vidal can meet the clan, sect, or non-infernal vampire trait (e.g., {Black Hand}) requirement to play any card. He can meet a given requirement only once each game. +1 bleed.

SchreckNET
Cardtype: Action
Clan: Nosferatu
+1 stealth action. Unique.
If this Nosferatu's capacity is 6 or more, he or she unlocks. Put this card in play. Whenever a referendum succeeds, you may lock this card to look at any Methuselah's hand.

Labyrinth, The
Clan: Nosferatu
Cost: 1 pool
Unique location.
You can lock this card to give a Nosferatu you control +1 stealth.

Stiff Contempt
Cardtype: Action Modifier
Clan: Samedi
Only usable as the action is announced.
Vampires must burn 1 blood to attempt to block this action.

Raking Talons
Cardtype: Combat
Clan: Gargoyle
Only usable before range is determined.
For the remainder of combat, damage from this Gargoyle's hand strikes is aggravated. A vampire may play only one Raking Talons each combat.

Razor Bat
Cardtype: Retainer
Clan: Gargoyle
Cost: 2 pool
Gargoyle creature with 2 life.
The Gargoyle with this retainer gets +1 intercept. When the Gargoyle with this retainer is in combat, the opposing minion takes 1R damage during the initial strike resolution phase of each round, at long or close range.

Thanks

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Vezintroll. wrote:
>
> If it is correct, I have some questions:
> If Mata Hari plays SchreckNET and there is a The Labyrinth in play (controlled by the same matuselah) Can I tap The labirinth to give +1 Stealth to Mata Hari during this action?
>
No, she is considered a Nosferatu only by the SchreckNET card. The Labyrinth sees her as s Ravnos.

> Vezintroll. wrote:
> If Mata Hari plays SchreckNET and during the action plays Stiff Contempt, What Clan is Mata Hari during this action? Nosferatu, Samedi or Both (Multiclan)?
>
SchreckNET sees her as a Nosferatu, Stiff Contempt as a Samedi. She doesn't change clan during the action.

> Vezintroll. wrote:
> If Mata Hari have a Razor Bat, and plays Raking Talons. Is Mata Hari Gargoyle until the end of the combat? Do the razorbat any damage during this combat?
>
The Razor Bat sees her as a Ravnos.

> Vezintroll. wrote:
> Does Vidal Jarbeaux's special text (diferent wording) working like Matahari's special text?
>
Not in these examples.
